title: Youth Mental Health Ecosystems for Thriving Young People
discussion_signal: The post reframes youth mental health as an ecosystem issue shaped by uncertainty, conflict, climate, inequality, digital life, education, work, housing, community, and culture. It also makes youth participation part of the proposed response, linking wellbeing to the surrounding social conditions rather than treatment alone.
linked_research_question: How do social, economic, digital, and cultural environments combine to shape youth mental health and agency?
limits: Institutional announcement rather than independent evaluation
No representative youth sample is visible in the post
The post does not establish which interventions improve outcomes
